$comment: Hand-maintained, minimal conformance status per runtime — not the full machine-readable report/matrix design in docs/REPOSITORY_SPLIT_AND_SPEC_SYNC.md §5 (cross-repo dispatch, sigstore transparency log), which remains deferred. Updated by an operator when a runtime's own CI is observed green against the pinned spec version below. specVersion here is what each runtime currently claims conformance for — it can lag spec/VERSION between a spec bump and that runtime's own update.
